notes: MiniMax H3 multi-frame reference to video with sound, from the official video_minimax_h3_multiframe_reference template (Reference to Video plus chained Add Guide for MiniMax H3). image1 (node 164) is ref_images slot 1, <Picture 1>: the identity and, through the prompt, the first frame; the template pins no guide at 0 s. image2 (157) and image3 (159) are pinned by Add Guide at image2Frame and image3Frame, frames at 24 fps (round(seconds x 24), each below length), and are also ref_images slots 2 and 3 so the prompt can name them <Picture 2> and <Picture 3>. The template's fourth guide, resolution selector, duration and frame-index math nodes are baked into literal inputs. Template default: no Lightning LoRA, 20 steps, because the 4-step turbo LoRA weakens identity and audio and the spike measures identity across cuts. For a faster draft, add a LoraLoaderModelOnly with minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfyui_bf16.safetensors between node 127 and node 126 and set node 124's steps to 4. ref_image_size match.
